top_categories.workout_context: 58ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Gray Duck Grit, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
At mile 60 of 111, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gray Duck Grit. Train it until it feels boring.
Gray Duck Grit's Gravel roads, Rural Minnesota forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 111 miles.
6,400ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gray Duck Grit's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 111 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
111 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 111 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 6,400ft of climbing on Minnesota gravel roads does to your power file on race day.
Tempo is Gray Duck Grit's race pace. The wattage you'll hold for 111 miles on Minnesota gravel roads. Train it until it's automatic.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Gray Duck Grit’s 111 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gray Duck Grit requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on minnesota gravel roads to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads, rural minnesota, rolling hills.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Durability to prepare you for 111 miles of minnesota gravel roads in Cannon Falls, Minnesota.
